So you've probably seen towel hang chin-ups and fingertip push-ups, those are great and all, but here's two exercises involving common materials that can be done almost everywhere, and are pretty impressive to out-of-shape people.

  1. Bottle cap bending: after you open the beverage of your choice (/v/bodyweightfitness recommends New Belgium 1554) crush the bottle cap between your thumb and index finger. Put the cap into an empty bottle. Repeat.

  2. Chair lifts: Pick up a four-legged chair/barstool by one leg, grabbing the leg from as close to the floor as possible. Lift the chair up, trying to hold it straight. It's easier if you hold the back leg, since the weight is centered over your hand. Also works the hell out of your forearms.

If you do these a lot, be sure to work out the opposite muscle group, either with rubber bands, or with fingertip push-ups.
